title: App defaults: the console's light look, no top toolbar
asked: Backfilled from CLAUDE.md Status (built before builds reported themselves).

result.summary: `framework/defaults.json` → `color-theme: arctic-daylight`, `style-theme: glass-orbit`; new **`framework/app-defaults.json`** (`app-defaults@1`) holds the non-slot defaults: `hidden: ["toolbar"]`. **`manifest.hidden`** (both ports: `AxfManifest.hidden`, TS `AxfManifest.hidden`) = chrome slots hidden

commits.message: Fix frozen Android apps; light theme + no toolbar by default; collapsible toolbar; designed assets at init
Widget kinds: eleven attachable widget types for banners and toolbars
